Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Computer Science BSc/MEng at University College London

What University College London asks of applicants to Computer Science BSc/MEng for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University College London courses · Computer Science field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 0 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma (UCL’s A*A*A band, this course’s offer): 5,5 in two APs plus SAT 1500 or ACT 34, taken in the final three years of high school, with the High School Graduation Diploma
  • Alternatively 5,5,5,5,5 in five APs (taken in the final three years of high school), with no SAT/ACT

Chain: the Computer Science BSc 2027-entry page (offer A*A*A) loads UCL’s international equivalency for its A-level band through its country selector; that data’s United States entry is shown here. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026UCL: Computer Science BSc (2027 entry) · UCL: 2027 international equivalency — United States (A*A*A band)
English language
  • UCL English language Level 1
  • IELTS Academic: 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in each component
  • TOEFL iBT (tests from 21 January 2026): 4.5 overall and 4.0 in each skill; earlier tests: 92 overall with 24/30 in reading and writing and 20/30 in speaking and listening
  • PTE Academic: 70 overall with at least 62 in each communicative skill
  • Not needed by nationals of UCL’s listed majority English-speaking countries (including the USA); for September 2027 entry a test must be taken on or after 1 September 2025

Level 1 is stated on the Computer Science MEng page; the BSc page’s English section was not captured by the text reader (the two courses share entry requirements). Other accepted tests and qualifications (e.g. Cambridge C1/C2, GCSE/IGCSE English) are listed on UCL’s English language page; 12 months of English-taught education in an approved country (including the USA) leading to a qualification also counts. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026UCL: Computer Science MEng (2027 entry) · UCL: Undergraduate English language requirements
Admissions tests
  • TARA (Test of Academic Reasoning for Admissions) — required for all applicants for 2027/28 entry; sit it in October 2026 or January 2027

The TARA FAQ page’s headings still mention 2026 in places, but its test dates are for the 2027-entry cycle. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026UCL: Computer Science BSc (2027 entry) · UCL Computer Science: TARA admissions test
Subject prerequisites
  • Required: A* in Mathematics or Further Mathematics
  • Preferred (as recorded): Further Mathematics / HL Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches

Official (2027 entry): an A* in either Mathematics or Further Mathematics is required; for the IB, HL Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches is preferred (Applications and Interpretation accepted). The A-level requirements do not name Further Mathematics as preferred.

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement: accepted — see note
  • Advanced Placement (UCL’s A*A*A band): 5,5,5,5,5 in five APs, or 5,5 in two APs plus SAT 1500 or ACT 34 with the High School Graduation Diploma
  • Subject requirements carry over:
    • an A* or A subject needs a 5 in the relevant full-year AP (a B needs a 4)
    • where Mathematics or Physics is required, specific AP subjects are asked for
  • AP scores must be verified and sent to UCL by the College Board

UCL’s 2027 international equivalency for the A*A*A band, which the course page’s country selector loads for this course. UCL also says one year at a recognised US university or college (CGPA 3.3/4.0, around 30 semester credits) may be considered. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026UCL: 2027 international equivalency — United States (A*A*A band)
Other requirements
  • TARA required (see Admissions tests); results are considered alongside A-level grades and the personal statement in a holistic review
  • Applications are assessed by a central UCL team against the published entry criteria; non-standard qualifications are referred to the Computer Science admissions tutor
  • Offer holders are invited to an offer-holder open day (in person or online)

The course page mentions no interview. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.
